title: Machine learning screens MXene single-atom catalysts and guides a Cr2CO2-Pt catalyst
summary: Theoretical-calculation data trained an ML model that screened MXene single-atom catalysts by hydrogen evolution barrier, yielding a simple structural descriptor tied to a d-band center near -2.7 eV. Guided by it, Cr2CO2-Pt was synthesized and reached 1 A cm-2 at an overpotential of 150.7 mV, with stability over 130 h.
ai_technology: Machine learning on computed hydrogen-evolution barriers, yielding a structural descriptor

evidence.tested: Synthesis and electrochemical testing of Cr2CO2-Pt.
evidence.unknown: Comparison against unscreened catalysts not stated in the abstract; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: ML predicted barriers and led to the descriptor.
